speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are not proposing to automate my tuning, you are proposing to ignore the data quality work I am doing. I need you to acknowledge that I am keeping this manual because the pipelines are not ready for your speed.
output.correction: I never said I was against automation, I said the data foundation is not stable enough to trust it yet. You filed this as a resistance to change, but it is a prerequisite for the model to actually work.
